question: The side of a square is 5 cm. How many times will the new area become, if the side of the square is doubled?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the **side** of a square is increased by a factor of **n**, then the **area** increases by a factor of **n²**.

Here, the side is **doubled**, so **n = 2**.

New Area = **2²** × Original Area = **4** × Original Area.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Original side of square = **5 cm**

**Formula Used:** Area of a square = **(side)²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/593d4ff52bbe759ec0f508bdb90a608e5afdf7444594f986741aac9afae2f85a.png] 

⇒ Original Area = **5 × 5** = **25 cm²**

⇒ New Side = **2 × 5** = **10 cm**

⇒ New Area = **10 × 10** = **100 cm²**

⇒ Ratio = **New Area ÷ Original Area** = **100 ÷ 25** = **4**

**∴ The correct answer is 4 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area Scaling Property

If the linear dimensions of any 2D shape are multiplied by **k**, the area is multiplied by **k²**.

Perimeter Scaling

If the side of a square is doubled, the **perimeter** also gets **doubled** (scaled by **k**).

Volume Scaling

For 3D objects like cubes, if the side is doubled, the **volume** becomes **2³ = 8 times** the original.</p
